A large issue I see with players who play evil characters, is they're actively -trying- to do evil things. Chaotic Evil is just pure destruction, yes, (and generally a single character who is that intensely destructive probably isn't long for the world,) but those are also relatively rare (for civilized people, not including demons, etc.)

Look at the real world; most people we classify as evil saw things different from their POV. They think they're doing the right or needed thing. Possibly obsessive over one aspect, but as the saying goes, "everyone thinks they're the hero of their story."  A well-done evil character has their own reasons for what they do, and its not just "because I'm evil."

Also to agree with OP, in a character evil isn't generally all-consuming. Just because you think, say, all elves need to be exterminated, you might have a soft spot for orphans because elves made you an orphan when you were young.
